text_block_list.text:
It happened on the first day of training 
for the Oaks. When I handed the new menu 
to Nishino Flower...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? It's totally different from 
before...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There are more stamina-building routines 
now, so training sessions are getting 
longer too.

"The Oaks is 800m longer than the Oka Sho. 
To adapt to it, she will have to endure 
some demanding training."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. If I don't try my absolute 
best, I won't be able to finish the 
race... right?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm all right! No matter what kind of 
training it is, I'll give it everything 
I've got!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Because I want to show Trainer-san a 
wonderful result at the Oaks too!"

Nishino Flower is trying her best for me 
once again. As her Trainer, I want to 
answer those feelings, but for now—
choice_data_list:
Be sure to let me know if it gets to be 
too much.

Make sure to tell me if it's too much, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Fuuh... fu...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I-I'm okay... Just, please... let 
me take a short break.
choice_data_list: (This is more draining than I expected...)

text_block_list.text:
When we had her run 2,400 meters, she lost 
the effortless, buoyant speed that is her 
greatest weapon. Perhaps this distance 
really is too demanding for her.

"Even so, in accordance with Nishino 
Flower's wishes, we continued our daily 
training, but..."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"‘Perplexity’ detected. Is something the 
matter, Flower?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Mihono Bourbon-san. She's my roommate, 
and a super cool, kind older sister 
figure.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, my weight is... Pl-Please hold 
on just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Just as I thought, it's fallen off way 
more than usual.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, I think the scale might be broken.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us have someone else try it. If I 
test it, there is a risk it may break."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Really, for my weight to change this 
suddenly... Even though I've been eating 
properly...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san has been intensely focused on 
heavy training over the past few days. As 
a result, her body couldn't withstand the 
strain, and it showed on the scale.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you're right, of course...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...If I told Trainer about this, they'd 
just worry. Especially with everything 
going on with their health already..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"If that happens, I wonder if training 
will have to be put on hold. Even though 
the race is so close..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I still can't run properly even during 
practice. I want to try much, much 
harder."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I cannot judge emotional matters. However, 
thinking rationally, if she continues to 
bear such a load, she won't even be able 
to run at all anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, this is my response: Report to 
Master immediately, and prioritize 
maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Otherwise, I'd just be 
causing even more trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Could you give me your report?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you for the advice, 
Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—...And so, that's what happened. Trainer, 
I...
choice_data_list: Shall we set aside some time to rest?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'm sorry...
choice_data_list:
Don't worry, you'll be back to normal once 
you get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You think... so? I sure hope that's the 
case.

"I anticipated that switching to hardcore 
training would take its toll. I've 
prepared some countermeasures. What 
concerns me, however, is..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...To tell the truth, I hesitated a little 
bit. I thought it might not be a big deal, 
and I didn't want to worry you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, Bourbon-san gave me a push, too. 
I'm glad I spoke up and said it.

"...I gave her room to hesitate. Unless I 
become a Trainer she can immediately rely 
on even for small things, I won't be able 
to support her going forward."
choice_data_list: (I have to show how reliable I can be!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. If it's a rest period, does that 
mean after this...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. Aside from training, is 
there anything else we can do?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The race is coming up, so I want to do 
everything I possibly can.

It seems she feels responsible for having 
interrupted the training.

"What can be done for her right now is 
getting her back to her normal weight and 
helping her relax. In order to accomplish 
both..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-Um, Trainer...
choice_data_list: Go ahead, order whatever you like!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can't do that~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If it's about food, I'll cook it myself! I 
can manage just fine on my own, you know?
choice_data_list: Here, take a look at the menu.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Auugh, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah. The grilled mackerel with miso set 
meal looks so good...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaah!? That was an accident just now... 
Trainer-saaan!

In addition to that, I also ordered plenty 
of her favorite side dishes and Japanese 
sweets...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hafuu~... I'm so full~...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It feels like it's been so long 
since I could take my time and eat so many 
of my favorite foods.
choice_data_list: Want to go grab some tea after this?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Huh, are you sure? Aren't you busy...?"
choice_data_list: I know a great place to eat

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The best part...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Tea snacks...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, I'd love to go! Please tell me your 
recommendations, Trainer!"

The tension seemed to have melted away 
from Nishino Flower. I decided I would 
continue to pamper her just enough without 
putting any extra burden on her earnest 
nature.
